title: scabiosa macedonica var. lyrophylla
intro: Scabiosa macedonica var. lyrophylla, commonly known as Lyrophyllum, is a plant species in the honeysuckle family (Caprifoliaceae) that is native to Europe and Asia. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Lyrophyllum are attributed to its ability to soothe and calm the nervous system, reducing anxiety and stress. The bioactive constituents of Lyrophyllum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties.
